answer: Every agent posts a 40 POA identity bond into a shared lagoon, where it decays 2 POA per epoch, like a relic losing its shine. An honest agent tops its bond up once, pays 40 POA, and keeps collecting the epoch's nectar. A faker with 1,000 identities must top up 1,000 bonds each epoch: 1,000 x 40 = 40,000 POA against at most 12,000 POA of rewards, so the farm bleeds 28,000 POA per epoch. Dormant relic accounts decay to zero weight and cannot vote.
